what_it_shows: 62 subcontractors handle PHI; current subcontractor BAAs on the company template for 57; the 5 inherited with the 2024 acquisition operate under legacy contracts that are being replaced; both cloud providers and the ticketing and notification vendors have signed subcontractor BAAs; Cloud provider B also hosts consumer data under a data processing agreement

title: Customer BAA template and BAA terms register
source_system: Contract management system; Privacy Office
what_it_shows: About 3,400 customer BAAs on a company template that commits the company to Security Rule compliance, subcontractor flow-down, and reporting of security incidents and breaches; notice terms recorded in the register range from 5 to 30 days; the notice-term field is blank for part of the register

title: Vendor SOC reports and provider compliance documentation on file
source_system: Third-party risk register; vendor portals
what_it_shows: SOC 2 Type 2 reports and shared responsibility documentation for Cloud providers A and B; SOC 2 reports for both colocation providers; SOC 2 Type 2 reports for the source repository, PLM, eQMS and ticketing vendors, each with a review record; provider compliance reports for the cloud key services

title: Contract manufacturer and component supplier agreements, receiving inspection and approved supplier list
source_system: Contract management system; supplier quality files
what_it_shows: CMO-1 builds about 30% of VM-700 subassemblies under a supply agreement with security terms and a current supplier security assessment; CMO-2 is the only source of HB-40 main boards, and its security terms are pending renewal; the IV-300 wireless module and CR-100 ECG sensor each have a single source; contract templates for build tools, HSMs, stations and firmware modules include security requirements and SBOM terms; receiving inspection of CMO-1 subassemblies checks firmware version and signature; approved supplier list

title: Interconnection register
source_system: GRC platform
what_it_shows: Interconnection agreements for the DDC update service, eQMS, ERP, the source repository SaaS, the PLM SaaS, and CMO-1 and CMO-2 image deliveries

title: Privacy Office breach log, assessment files and notice templates
source_system: Privacy Office tracker
what_it_shows: Four-factor assessments for DDC and RCM privacy incidents, shared with the affected customer; customer notice dates since 2025-01; a notice template with individual lists and the 164.404(c) elements; consumer app incidents are handled under the HIPAA breach procedure and templates; the tracker has no FTC rule log

title: Consumer app release checklist, processor list and support routing rules
source_system: Consumer Health release records; consumer support vendor configuration
what_it_shows: The release checklist includes a pre-release privacy review and no standing review of third-party analytics and crash-reporting kits in the app; processor contracts for the consumer platform do not refer to the company's status under 16 CFR Part 318; consumer privacy tickets go to the consumer support vendor's queue

title: RCM patient enrollment, notice, consent and request records
source_system: RCM platform administration; RCM operations logs
what_it_shows: Patient enrollment notices and consent records; phone gateway app permission prompts; patient-device pairing and demographic checks; access and correction requests forwarded to the covered entity under the BAA; disclosure and inquiry logs; retention terms recorded for practice contracts; physician directory validation and a second check for manual routing overrides; call-back verification for phone requests

title: Physical access, facility security plans and disposal records
source_system: Physical access system; facilities library; IT asset disposition records
what_it_shows: Badge-controlled data center cages and plant server rooms, with access lists reviewed quarterly; HSMs in locked racks with two-person access; guards at FL-1 and TX-1; cameras at plant perimeters; facility security plans and contingency access procedures for both monitoring centers; visitor logs; maintenance records for monitoring center security repairs; certificates of destruction for retired assets and HSM zeroization records

title: AI governance committee register and AI intake controls
source_system: GRC platform AI register; procurement and IT change management rules
what_it_shows: The register lists 11 AI use cases (AI-001 to AI-011) with owners, tiers and status; 7 have a completed committee review; AI-004, AI-006, AI-009 and AI-011 have none; since 2026-03, procurement and IT change management block AI features without an inventory ID; unapproved public generative AI domains are blocked; AI-002 performance is monitored monthly against technician review

title: AI-001 data management plan and held-out test report
source_system: PLM design history file (AI-001)
what_it_shows: Training data composition by sex and body mass index band: women and patients with a body mass index of 35 or more make up a smaller share of the training set than of the intended-use population; held-out internal test results by subgroup show a larger estimation error for patients with a body mass index of 35 or more

title: Supply chain risk management plan and criticality analysis, 2026
source_system: GRC platform
what_it_shows: SCRM plan covering software suppliers, firmware modules and contract manufacturers; criticality analysis naming signing keys, the manufacturing PKI and release promotion as critical functions

title: Plant maintenance records and QMS record retention schedule
source_system: Plant maintenance systems; eQMS document control
what_it_shows: Station and MES maintenance scheduled and recorded in the plant maintenance systems; the QMS record retention schedule covers release, signing and production records, with 6-year retention for HIPAA documentation

title: Tier-1 DR exercise reports, 2026-05-16
source_system: DR test records (CIO office)
what_it_shows: Received after the intake window (requested at intake): the DDC failed over to its warm standby region within its 2-hour RTO; the identity platform recovered within its 1-hour objective; DC-2 took over for the artifact repository; the build farm rebuild from infrastructure code took 30 hours against a 24-hour RTO; the DC-1 hurricane season plan was exercised

title: BIA interviews with process owners
source_system: Interviews (Vice Presidents of Digital Health, Remote Monitoring Services, Consumer Health, Supply Chain and Field Service; CTO; CQRO; VP Product Security; plant directors; Chief Accounting Officer; Chief Human Resources Officer)
what_it_shows: Each owner's description of their process, the systems, third parties and people it uses, its manual workaround, and the longest outage and data loss they say it can tolerate; RCM owners cite urgent arrhythmia calls and 24 hours of phone buffering; plant directors cite finished-goods buffers; the CQRO cites FDA reporting clocks; the Chief Accounting Officer cites the quarter-end filing window

title: BIA dependency and contract review
source_system: Vendor contracts; DR test records; contract RTO schedules
what_it_shows: Contract RTOs, alternates and last test dates for 26 dependencies (for example eQMS 12 hours, ERP 8 hours, HSM vendor support 8 hours, source repository 4 hours, notification service 4 hours); 13 rely on a single provider or instance; 2 have never been tested

title: FL-1 and TX-1 MES cluster failover test record, 2026-06-02
source_system: MES administration (observation)
what_it_shows: Cluster failover at FL-1 and TX-1 was run on 2026-06-02 and production resumed within the planned window; nightly configuration backups were available

title: Risk analysis workshops
source_system: Workshops (SOC, PSIRT, plants, build and release engineering, Integration Management Office, Privacy Office, Consumer Health, Remote Monitoring Services, AI governance committee, Finance)
what_it_shows: Owners' accounts of past incidents, near misses and threat scenarios and the controls they rely on; some hospitals expose the DG-10 management interface and install monitors on flat networks; RCM staff use manual routing overrides and receive phone requests; hospitals run the US-20 app on their own tablets, with a minimum OS check in the app; AI-011 ranking was disabled in 2026-06; a deal checklist has been used for acquisitions since 2026; engineers have easy access to public AI tools

title: Product security risk assessments in the product risk management files
source_system: PLM product risk management files
what_it_shows: Security risk assessments for each current product rate exploitability and link to the safety risk file; ratings for the legacy VM-500 and IV-300 first-generation designs

title: Gap analysis interviews with control owners
source_system: Interviews (CQRO; VP Product Security; Chief Privacy Officer; General Counsel; Chief Compliance Officer; Director of Security Operations; Director of Identity and Access Management; Vice President, Consumer Health; Vice President, Remote Monitoring Services)
what_it_shows: Owners' descriptions of how each requirement is carried out today and where the records are kept; the General Counsel states that the Item 106 statements are not tested by Internal Audit before filing

title: Gap analysis samples: section 524B, premarket and postmarket records
source_system: PSIRT case system; release records; submission files; SBOM service
what_it_shows: 4 of 4 submissions for cyber devices since 2023-03-29 included cybersecurity content and independent penetration test and fuzzing reports; 25 of 138 CVD reports (2025-07 to 2026-06) sampled, 1 acknowledged in 5 business days; 12 of 12 scheduled security releases checked, 1 IV-300 v2 release 5 weeks late; the expedited path was used twice, with fixes available in 19 and 26 days; 7 of 7 released SBOMs present, 5 with undecomposed supplier modules; 17 KEV matches in current product SBOMs (2026 H1), each with an assessment; 3 uncontrolled-risk cases with advisories on days 21, 27 and 34 and fixes on days 19, 26 and 52

title: Gap analysis samples: design changes, complaints, service, MDR and 806 records
source_system: eQMS; PLM; enterprise service system
what_it_shows: 22 of 22 design changes to cyber devices (2026 H1) carried a security impact entry; 60 of 412 complaints with the cybersecurity flag had a documented review and MDR decision; 60 of 1,904 USB security update visits recorded, 11 of them in the legacy IV-300 service tool; 25 of 61 PSIRT cases closed with a field update (2025-07 to 2026-06) sampled, 2 without a documented 806 decision or 806.20 record

title: Gap analysis samples: business associate safeguards
source_system: SOC review records; identity governance; HR system; SOC case management; backup reports; contract repository; badge system; disposal records
what_it_shows: 5 of 26 weekly DDC and RCM access reviews (2026 H1) completed; 60 of 2,112 terminations of staff with DDC or RCM access disabled the same day; 60 of 412 RCM role changes sampled, 3 technician transfers kept prior monitoring center roles 10 to 16 days; 25 of 214 security incidents touching DDC or RCM handled through all phases, with the BAA notice term not quickly found in 7; 25 of 181 daily backup jobs completed; 62 of 62 PHI subcontractors checked, 5 without a current BAA; 4 of 4 quarterly badge reviews completed; 25 of 1,210 disposed assets with certificates

title: Gap analysis samples: privacy incidents and breach notices
source_system: Privacy Office tracker; SOC case management; customer notices
what_it_shows: 25 of 38 privacy incidents (2026 H1) had a four-factor assessment shared with the customer and a recorded discovery time; 9 of 9 breach notices to customers (2025-01 to 2026-06) were sent within 60 days, median 11 days, and one was sent 2 days after a 5-day BAA term

title: Outside counsel memo on the FTC Health Breach Notification Rule and the companion app
source_system: General Counsel's office
what_it_shows: Counsel's analysis that the companion app is a personal health record and the company is a vendor of personal health records for it under 16 CFR 318.2, and that 318.1(a) excludes the DDC and RCM business associate services

title: Consumer app pre-release privacy review record, 2026-07
source_system: Consumer Health release records
what_it_shows: A pre-release privacy review stopped an app version whose analytics software kit would have sent health-related event names to an analytics vendor

title: FTC rule readiness document review
source_system: Processor contracts; Privacy Office procedures and templates; app settings
what_it_shows: 14 processors for the consumer platform, none told of the company's status under the rule; no FTC-specific notice procedure or templates; HIPAA templates do not include rule-specific content such as the identity of third parties that acquired the information; the 60-day clock is tracked for HIPAA matters only

title: External TLS scan of internet-facing services and device endpoints
source_system: Scanner run by Security Operations for the GRC team
what_it_shows: External interfaces of the DDC, RCM and consumer platforms accept TLS 1.2 or higher; the IV-300 first-generation drug library listener negotiates TLS 1.0

title: Threat model, architecture and design documentation review
source_system: PLM design history files
what_it_shows: Threat models for current products cover the update service, DG-10 gateways and the build and signing path, with a DG-10 exposure scenario added 2026-07; the IV-300 v2 threat model omits the drug library service; architecture views include multi-patient harm through the update service; current devices log security events to the DDC, authenticate telemetry messages and keep full clinical function when disconnected; component reviews and supplier module assessments at selection; the IV-300 first-generation design uses per-hospital pre-shared keys

title: AI governance committee portfolio review, 2026-08-26
source_system: AI governance committee minutes and review packages
what_it_shows: Re-review of AI-001 and the portfolio; review dates of 2026-11-30 set for AI-004, AI-006, AI-009 and AI-011

title: Control assessment: Account management samples
source_system: Identity governance workflows; repository and MES user exports; vendor rosters; Director of Identity and Access Management interview
what_it_shows: 60 sampled account events matched approved requests and role templates; 9 of 60 sampled contractor departures kept repository access 4 to 21 days after the contract end date; account managers were not notified when sponsors ended engagements early; MN-1 shared operator passwords were not changed when 31 operators left in the period

title: Control assessment: Access enforcement test
source_system: Branch protection exports; artifact repository permission export; test pushes with an auditor test account
what_it_shows: Branch protection and release repository permissions were enforced as designed for 25 sampled firmware repositories

title: Control assessment: Separation of duties in signing
source_system: Signing portal approval rules; signing group roster; legacy workstation procedure; observed signing test
what_it_shows: The signing portal required two approvers who did not submit the request; the legacy IV-300 1.x signing workstation relies on email approval and does not enforce separation between requester and approver

title: Control assessment: Pipeline credential scope test
source_system: Runner configuration; token inventory (46 credentials); token scope test
what_it_shows: Cloud runners receive a 90-day token with write access to the artifact repository, a wider scope than the builds use

title: Control assessment: Remote access review
source_system: Remote access inventory; PAM configuration; MN-1 station vendor contracts
what_it_shows: The 5 remote access paths are documented with usage and configuration requirements; two MN-1 station vendors connect with their own remote tools without per-connection authorization or PAM

title: Control assessment: Awareness training records
source_system: Learning system reports; phishing campaign results (6 months)
what_it_shows: Awareness training was current for all 60 sampled users; phishing simulations ran each month

title: Control assessment: Role-based training records
source_system: Role-based training records; course content
what_it_shows: Role-based content current and delivered before access for approvers, HSM administrators and OT engineers; 11 of 60 sampled engineers (18%) were overdue for the annual secure coding module

title: Control assessment: Event logging test
source_system: STD-01.4 event list; SIEM search results for generated events
what_it_shows: All 6 event types generated in test were logged

title: Control assessment: Audit review records
source_system: SOC review records (5 sampled weeks); SIEM source list (31 sources); monthly manual review notes
what_it_shows: Signing and promotion events from connected sources were reviewed daily; the legacy signing workstation and the MN-1 MES server do not send logs to the SIEM, and their manual monthly reviews missed 2 of 6 months

title: Control assessment: Non-repudiation of signing
source_system: Signing portal records; HSM audit log; legacy signing log and approval emails
what_it_shows: The signing portal binds each signature to two named approvers; the 9 legacy IV-300 signings in 2026 H1 have only an email trail that does not bind approvers to the signing act

title: Control assessment: Audit generation configuration
source_system: Logging configuration exports for the repository tenant, build orchestrator, signing portal, HSMs, artifact repository and FL-1 and TX-1 MES
what_it_shows: Audit generation was enabled on all tested components

title: Control assessment: Continuous monitoring metrics
source_system: Monthly metrics packages (3 sampled months); CISO interview
what_it_shows: Monthly metrics were produced, reviewed and acted on

title: Control assessment: Baseline configuration review
source_system: Baseline repository; drift reports; MN-1 server review
what_it_shows: Build nodes and FL-1 and TX-1 MES match documented baselines; no documented baseline exists for the MN-1 MES server or MN-1 stations

title: Control assessment: Firmware release change control sample
source_system: PLM release records; artifact promotion logs; change board minutes (40 of 184 releases, 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30)
what_it_shows: Sampled releases had change records with security impact analysis; 3 of 40 sampled firmware releases were promoted to the update service before the PLM release approval was recorded (1 IV-300 v2, 2 HB-40); promotion logs are not reconciled to PLM approvals

title: Control assessment: Promotion gate test
source_system: Promotion gate configuration; test promotions without an approved record
what_it_shows: The gate blocked promotion without approval for VM-700, DG-10, CR-100, US-20 and cloud software; IV-300 v2 and HB-40 lines use a manual checklist and the gate is not enforced for them

title: Control assessment: Access restrictions for change
source_system: PAM session records (10 changes); MN-1 local administrator export

title: Control assessment: Configuration settings checks
source_system: Configuration compliance reports; 40 settings checked on 30 stations and all servers
what_it_shows: FL-1 and TX-1 stations and build nodes met the benchmark; MN-1 stations deviated from 14 of 40 checked settings, with no documented approval for the deviations

title: Control assessment: Least functionality checks
source_system: Station allowlist and USB policy checks on 30 stations
what_it_shows: FL-1 and TX-1 stations block USB storage and non-allowlisted software; MN-1 stations allow USB storage devices

title: Control assessment: Component inventory trace
source_system: CMDB; passive discovery reports; SBOM service; supplier SBOM register

title: Control assessment: Unsigned image test at stations

title: Control assessment: Contingency plan testing review
source_system: DR test report; test schedule; HSM failover history
what_it_shows: Build farm and artifact repository tests were run and reviewed; secondary HSM failover was last tested in 2025-06

title: Control assessment: Backup and restore records
source_system: Backup job reports (25 sampled jobs); restore test records
what_it_shows: Backups ran and are protected; restores were tested for FL-1 and TX-1 MES and the artifact repository; MN-1 MES backups have never been restore-tested

title: Control assessment: Recovery test review
source_system: 2026-05 DR test report
what_it_shows: The artifact repository was reconstituted to a known state; build farm recovery took 30 hours against the 24-hour RTO

title: Control assessment: Identification and authentication test
source_system: SSO logs (25 sampled sign-ins); MN-1 account export
what_it_shows: SSO with MFA for engineering and FL-1 and TX-1 plant users; MN-1 operators use 14 shared logins

title: Control assessment: Privileged MFA test

what_it_shows: Phishing-resistant MFA was enforced for all privileged accounts

title: Control assessment: Station authentication test

what_it_shows: Sampled stations authenticated with PKI certificates

title: Control assessment: Incident handling sample
source_system: SOC case records; PSIRT cases; lessons-learned records (25 of 37 incidents)
what_it_shows: Sampled incidents were handled through all phases

title: Control assessment: Incident reporting sample
source_system: PSIRT cases; eQMS 806 records (25 of 61 cases)
what_it_shows: Incidents were reported internally on time; 2 of 25 sampled PSIRT cases lacked a documented 806 reporting decision

title: Control assessment: Termination sample

title: Control assessment: Public disclosure program review
source_system: CVD policy; ISAO membership

title: Control assessment: External services review

title: Control assessment: Unsupported components review

source_system: SOC monitoring coverage; test alert results

title: Control assessment: Supply chain controls review
source_system: Supplier SBOM register; SCRM plan (38 modules)

title: Control assessment: Component authenticity review
source_system: PKI issuance logs; CMO process reviews (2 contract manufacturers)
